state.question: Which approved macro fits a user who can sign in but cannot export a report?

expected_request.instruction: Draft evidence-linked support reply macros. Use only the supplied structured evidence. Produce a concise candidate for human review; never execute, send, publish, certify, grade, or infer causality. Include the exact source_id and source_ref, preserve evidence_quote verbatim, and report context_count exactly. Set macro_key to a concise value grounded in the supplied facts.

content.text: Draft for draft evidence-linked support reply macros: A saved reply can point the user to the export permission check and ask them to retry after access is confirmed. [source_id=MWI-078-A; source_ref=support-case/CASE-781]
